sql:
WITH county AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, "School Name", "Free Meal Count (K-12)", "Enrollment (K-12)",
         "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS rate
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda' AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS ar FROM county
),
top_school AS (
  SELECT * FROM county ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t."School Name",
  s.Charter,
  s.GSserved,
  CASE
    WHEN sa.NumTstTakr IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS SAT_Performance,
  t.rate - a.ar AS deviation_from_county_average
FROM top_school t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = SUBSTR(t.CDSCode, 1, 7) || '0000000'
CROSS JOIN avg_rate a

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS free_meal_count,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 'High Poverty'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.50 THEN 'Medium-High Poverty'
      WHEN f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.25 THEN 'Medium-Low Poverty'
      ELSE 'Low Poverty'

    sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,

    sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_scr_math,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_scr_write,
    sa.NumGE1500 AS num_ge1500,
    CAST(sa.NumGE1500 AS REAL) * 100 / sa.NumTstTakr AS excellence_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
    AND s.Charter = 1
    AND s.County = 'San Joaquin'
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  city,
  enrollment_k12,
  free_meal_count,
  frpm_count,
  frpm_pct,
  poverty_level,
  num_test_takers,
  avg_scr_read,
  avg_scr_math,
  avg_scr_write,
  num_ge1500,
  excellence_rate,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY enrollment_k12 DESC) AS enrollment_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY enrollment_k12 DESC

WITH owners AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, c.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
inc AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS income
  FROM trans WHERE type = 'PRIJEM' GROUP BY account_id
),
exp AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS expense
  FROM trans WHERE type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  o.gender,
  CASE WHEN (2024 - CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_date,1,4) AS INTEGER)) < 30 THEN 'Young'
       WHEN (2024 - CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_date,1,4) AS INTEGER)) <= 50 THEN 'Middle-aged'
       ELSE 'Senior' END AS age_group,
  di.A3 AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.client_id) AS client_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.account_id) AS account_count,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(o.birth_date,1,4) AS INTEGER)), 1) AS avg_birth_year,
  SUM(COALESCE(i.income, 0)) AS total_income,
  SUM(COALESCE(e.expense, 0)) AS total_expense,
  SUM(COALESCE(i.income, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(e.expense, 0)) AS net_flow,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(i.income, 0)), 2) AS avg_income,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(e.expense, 0)), 2) AS avg_expense
FROM owners o
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = o.district_id
LEFT JOIN inc i ON i.account_id = o.account_id
LEFT JOIN exp e ON e.account_id = o.account_id
GROUP BY o.gender, age_group, di.A3
ORDER BY o.gender, age_group, di.A3

WITH c AS (
  SELECT client_id, district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date = '1976-01-29'
),
acc AS (
  SELECT d.client_id, a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date AS account_date
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM c)

ta AS (
  SELECT account_id,

         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit,

lo AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_loan_amount,
         AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount,
         MAX(status) AS loan_status
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
ca AS (
  SELECT d.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS card_count,
         MAX(c.type) AS card_type,
         MAX(c.issued) AS card_issued
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  GROUP BY d.account_id

  acc.frequency,

  di.A2 AS district_name,

  ta.last_trans_date,
  COALESCE(lo.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
  lo.total_loan_amount,
  lo.avg_loan_amount,
  lo.loan_status,
  COALESCE(ca.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
  ca.card_type,
  ca.card_issued
FROM acc
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = acc.district_id
LEFT JOIN ta ON ta.account_id = acc.account_id
